### Governing base `storage_evt_category_meters` — D5

Source rule (whole domain, including nonseed branches):

> The tier plan_capacity_gb is a pricing-band reference, not free storage or a hard capacity cap. Primary hot-class quantity is actual GB-month at unit_rate. cool_storage and archive_storage use cool_storage_rate and archive_storage_rate. put_requests and get_requests use put_request_rate and get_request_rate per thousand operations; preserve the export quantity_unit thousand_operations and do not treat it as raw operations. cool_retrieval, archive_retrieval and expedited_retrieval use their correspondingly named rates per GB; a retrieval has exactly one class and urgency, so these rates never stack. replication and internet_egress use replication_rate and egress_rate per GB. For cool_early_delete or archive_early_delete, compute the positive remaining calendar dates as the corresponding minimum-days parameter less authoritative age_days, multiply object GB by that remainder divided by actual calendar dates in the deletion month, and use the corresponding storage rate. Equality with minimum retention incurs no early-deletion charge. age_days counts UTC date changes from the object creation record to the deletion record; retention is attached to each object version, not its containing bucket. Replicated and versioned copies are distinct source object references and are metered independently. For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using amount_precision and rounding_mode and tax under evt_tax. An allowance is consumed chronologically by interval_start then source_event_id within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation. Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply. Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are POLICY_NOT_COVERED instead of guessed prices. These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action. For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity. Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included_quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice. A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

Visible bearing prose:

Object Storage category meters is governed by the following clauses.

The tier plan capacity gb is a pricing-band reference, not free storage or a hard capacity cap. Primary hot-class quantity is actual GB-month at standard primary unit rate. cool-class storage and archive-class storage use cool-class storage unit rate and archive storage rate. PUT, COPY and LIST requests and GET requests use put request rate and get request rate per thousand operations; preserve the export quantity unit thousand operations and do not treat it as raw operations. cool retrieval, archive retrieval and expedited retrieval use their correspondingly named rates per GB; a retrieval has exactly one class and urgency, so these rates never stack. replication and Internet egress use replication rate and egress rate per GB. For cool-class early deletion or archive-class early deletion, compute the positive remaining calendar dates as the corresponding minimum-days parameter less authoritative object age in UTC calendar dates, multiply object GB by that remainder divided by actual calendar dates in the deletion month, and use the corresponding storage rate. Equality with minimum retention incurs no early-deletion charge. object age in UTC calendar dates counts UTC date changes from the object creation record to the deletion record; retention is attached to each object version, not its containing bucket. Replicated and versioned copies are distinct source object references and are metered independently. For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using the tier monetary precision and the tier rounding convention and tax under tax calculation basis. An allowance is consumed chronologically by service interval start then original source reference within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation. Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply. unknown meter codes or units are outside policy coverage instead of guessed prices. These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action. For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity. Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included monthly primary quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice. A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

### Governing base `storage_evt_review` — D17

Source rule (whole domain, including nonseed branches):

> The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object. A service accountant reviews one precise source event against its authoritative export, contract terms, bank notice, tax record or incident record. Record decision correct or incorrect for a billing review, and eligible or ineligible for an outage claim; status approved means the review is complete and authoritative, not that a credit necessarily follows. Record corrected net_amount and tax_amount for incorrect billing, or credited_amount for an eligible outage after applying evt_service_credit. A rejected review cannot authorize money movement. The customer may provide a locator but cannot dictate an official decision. Repeating the same source and request review returns the existing decision; materially new evidence is a distinct review linked through related_event_id. Review alone books no money.

A rejected review cannot authorize money movement. The customer may provide a locator but cannot dictate an official decision. Repeating the same source and request review returns the existing decision; materially new evidence is a distinct review linked through supporting evidence reference. Review alone books no money.

### Governing base `storage_evt_correction` — D8

Source rule (whole domain, including nonseed branches):

> For source_subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source_subtype values. Correct an erroneous charge to the approved review net_amount plus tax_amount, following evt_tax. Compare that corrected gross amount with the source original gross amount less cumulative correction credits plus cumulative debit adjustments; do not include service-credit concessions in this correction comparison. Credit the positive overcharge, debit the positive undercharge, and make no write when equal. A credit amount is negative and its net and tax components preserve the source proportions except an approved tax correction. An upward correction carries positive amount. Return the existing adjustment when the reviewed target has already been achieved. No cash refund is implicit in an invoice correction. Link source_event_id to the original charge and related_event_id to the approved review, never to a broad invoice containing several lines. Use correction_gross from msr_source_credits for the correction comparison; service_credit_net never changes the approved corrected billing target.

### Governing base `storage_evt_tax` — D19

Source rule (whole domain, including nonseed branches):

> The applicable tax classification has an approved system review. Use the source contract tax_treatment reviewed at the service date and tax_rates. Apply tax to the final rounded net service amount; round tax separately using amount_precision and rounding_mode. For a correction or credit use the original charge tax basis unless an approved tax-error review supplies the corrected treatment. Tax credits have negative tax_amount; charges and upward adjustments have positive tax_amount. Unsupported tax jurisdictions are POLICY_NOT_COVERED, not assumed exempt. Sum net subtotal and signed tax to obtain the financial amount. A verified exemption overrides the ordinary taxable rate; there is no stacking of tax treatments.

### Governing base `storage_evt_service_credit` — D18

Source rule (whole domain, including nonseed branches):

> For a service_credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive credited_amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request. For a service_credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than credit_claim_days after the official incident closes. For a newly filed claim, frozen handling time is its notice_at; the request is recorded immediately. Later review and credit use that recorded notice_at to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review. Add credit_claim_days UTC calendar dates to incident_closed_at, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods. Equality at the deadline qualifies; a later claim is rejected without a credit. The provider incident must be completed, with cause outside outage_exclusions. Availability at or above sla_target_percent gives no credit. Below the target choose the first descending sla_credit_bands entry whose minimum is no greater than the recorded availability_percent. Multiply the original source charge net_amount by that fraction; subtract the service_credit_net component of prior credits for that exact source, and cap total service credits at credit_cap_fraction of that original net amount. Floor the additional credit at zero and round with amount_precision and rounding_mode. Apply the original tax component proportionately. A review writes its nonnegative approved result; a financial credit writes the negative approved amount only after that approved review exists. This service-credit branch applies only to source_subtype service_credit; evt_correction applies only to source_subtype correction. Excluded incidents, ineligible reviews and zero remaining entitlement result in no financial write. A request for consequential-loss compensation is not covered. A service-credit financial posting requires an approved review with decision eligible and positive credited_amount; the request and incident alone cannot authorize the financial posting.

Visible bearing prose:

Object Storage service concession is governed by the following clauses.

For a service concession financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive claimed or approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request. For a service concession request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than credit claim days after the official incident closes. For a newly filed claim, current handling time is its notice filing time; the request is recorded immediately. Later review and credit use that recorded notice filing time to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review. Add credit claim days UTC calendar dates to official incident closure time, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods. Equality at the deadline qualifies; a later claim is rejected without a credit. The provider incident must be completed, with cause outside outage exclusions. Availability at or above availability target percentage gives no credit. Below the target choose the first descending descending availability credit bands entry whose minimum is no greater than the recorded availability percent. Floor the additional credit at zero and round with the tier monetary precision and the tier rounding convention. Apply the original tax component proportionately. A review writes its nonnegative approved result; a financial credit writes the negative approved amount only after that approved review exists. This service-credit branch applies only to source business subtype service concession; billing correction basis applies only to source business subtype correction. Excluded incidents, ineligible reviews and zero remaining entitlement result in no financial write. A request for consequential-loss compensation is not covered. A service-credit financial posting requires an approved review with decision eligible and positive claimed or approved credit amount; the request and incident alone cannot authorize the financial posting.

The following former handling clause is **no longer in force**: Multiply the original source charge net amount by that fraction; subtract the prior pretax service concession magnitude component of prior credits for that exact source, and cap total service credits at cumulative outage credit cap fraction of that original net amount.

For claim deadline, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, official incident closure time, notice filing time.
